title: Strict reduction of completed extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I\subset A$ a finitely generated ideal, $A/I$ additive torsion, and $P_n=A/I^n$ finite and perfect over $A$ for every $n\geq1$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work on the small pro-etale sites, with constant $A$-module sheaves and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $J_j$ for the exact module extension by zero along the localized site, also applied termwise to strict inverse sequences and complexes [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact, lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$ [def-weil-inverse-system], and use the diagram-site model [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Define the strict reduction functor $\mathcal R_T(M)=\Delta M\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}(\underline{P_n}_T)_n$, computed on one flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $C_TM=R\lim\mathcal R_T(M)$ be completion with its specified unit $\eta_M:M\to C_TM$ [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], and put $J_j^cK=C_X(J_jK)$.

Extension by zero sends flat-term K-flat complexes to flat-term K-flat complexes. The tensor projection comparison gives a natural isomorphism of actual derived strict towers
$$\mathcal R_X(J_jK)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_U(K).$$
For every $K\in D(U,A)$, the morphism $\mathcal R_X(\eta_{J_jK})$ is invertible, and its inverse followed by this tensor comparison defines
$$q_{j,K}:\mathcal R_X(J_j^cK)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_U(K),\qquad q_{j,K}\,\mathcal R_X(\eta_{J_jK})=q^{\rm tens}_{j,K}.$$
At each $n$, its inverse is the reduction of the completion unit and its forward map is the adjoint of the $n$-th limit projection; in particular $(J_j^cK)\otimes_A^LP_n\cong J_j(K\otimes_A^LP_n)$. These statements are natural in $K$ and respect every quotient transition before taking $R\lim$. Moreover $J_j^cK$ is complete and its completion presentation gives the specified natural isomorphism $J_j^cK\cong R\lim(J_j\mathcal R_UK)$. If the reductions of $K$ have bounded-below etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], those of $J_j^cK$ have the extension-by-zero witnesses through [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. No completeness of ordinary $J_jK$, and no commutation of ordinary $J_j$ with inverse limits, is asserted.
